title: What's New: Copilot for Sustainability (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction and challenges with sustainability emissions
Copilot workflow and emission factor calculation process
Preparing and managing emission factor files
Demo with matched emission factors and sources
Handling warnings and improving descriptions with regeneration
Availability, language support and future roadmap

features.name: Calculate CO2 copilot action
features.description: A copilot feature that calculates total emissions, updates emission factors if configured, and adds source information for auditing in sustainability journal entries.
caveats: Requires proper line description for system to understand emissions type
Only officially supports English language in first release
Requires uploaded files or public information to match emissions

features.name: Emission factor file uploads
features.description: Users can prepare and upload Excel files containing emission factors organized by columns, which the copilot uses to find matches for different types of emissions across countries and manufacturers.
caveats: Files should be cut down to only necessary information for performance
Files can be organized by country or type
Obsolete files can be marked and removed easily

features.name: Automated emission factor suggestions
features.description: When running copilot, if emission factors already exist in the system for a line, they are displayed as automated suggestions without calling the LLM. Only missing factors trigger LLM processing.
features.status_evidence_quote: this first release it will be delivered as a public preview
caveats: Only applies when emission factors exist in system
Requires uploaded files or public sources for matches

features.name: Contextual warnings for missing data
features.description: The system provides pre-processing contextual warnings to alert users when required information is missing from entries, helping improve data quality before posting.
features.status_evidence_quote: in this first release it will be delivered as a public preview
caveats: Warnings help identify data gaps but require user action
Distance or other required measures must be provided

features.name: Public information fallback
features.description: When uploaded files do not contain a match for emissions data, the system attempts to find matching information from publicly available sources and recommends those emissions factors.
features.status_evidence_quote: in this first release it will be delivered as a public preview
caveats: Fallback to public information when uploaded files do not match
Source attribution shows as public information

features.name: Description refinement and regeneration
features.description: Users can update line descriptions in the copilot suggestion page to improve matching accuracy and click regenerate to get more precise emission factor recommendations without returning to the journal.
features.status_evidence_quote: in this first release it will be delivered as a public preview
caveats: Requires accurate descriptions like 'large motorbike' rather than just 'motorbike'
Regeneration available only when copilot suggestion page is open

features.name: Calculation explanation transparency
features.description: For each emission calculation, the copilot provides detailed formula explanations showing the calculation method, values used, and final results for verification and auditing purposes.
features.status_evidence_quote: in this first release it will be delivered as a public preview
caveats: Formulas vary based on emission type - distance for cars, nights for hotels, calculated distance for flights
All underlying values must be present in Business Central

features.name: Flexible emission factor update settings
features.description: Users can configure whether the system should update emission factors for future use when new calculations are completed, or keep them as single-use entries.
features.status_evidence_quote: in this first release it will be delivered as a public preview
caveats: Configuration is system-wide setting, not per-entry
Useful when accounting for multiple values under same account
